summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #39. Deliverables committed: (1) vendored byte-identical copy of the upstream solver parity corpus at ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/parity/v1/corpus.json (upstream viamin/color_matching a82aec5, algorithm_version 1, sha256 7b7b4d90...f8604); (2) SolverParityCorpusTests.swift replaying all 12 scenarios (score tables, selections, tie evidence, exclusions, unknown-weight handling, CompositionSolver fast-path 1x1 replay); (3) PaletteAPIClientMigrationContractTests.swift pinning the /api/v1 wire + error-mapping contract the generated OpenAPI client migration must preserve; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location, refresh procedure, consumption, and the implementation-run plan. BLOCKER: no Swift toolchain exists in this container (swift/swiftc/xcrun absent), so `swift test` could NOT be executed; bin/lint detects the missing toolchain and skips the build per its own design. Supplementary external evidence: an independent Python replay of the documented scorer semantics (exclusion on missing positive-weight channel, zero-weight ignored, earliest-wins ties, unknown weight keys ignored) matches all 12 corpus scenarios with 0 failures (5 tie scenarios, 4 exclusion scenarios), confirming the fixture is consistent with WeightedSquaredErrorScorer semantics. Implementation deliverables (swift-openapi-generator/runtime packaging, PaletteAPIClient migration, README edit) are deferred to the implementation run by the test-only phase rules enforced on this run.
blockers: Swift toolchain not installed in this container: `swift test` and test compilation could not run. Verify on a macOS/Linux host with Swift >= 5.9 via `cd ColorComposerCore && swift test`.

Test-writing phase rules prohibit changing implementation files (Package.swift, PaletteAPIClient.swift, README.md); generated-client packaging/migration and README linkage must land in the implementation run.
